close_reason: defined pkix_revocation::Error with Revoked+Unavailable variants, Display, and Result alias; updated RevocationChecker and NoRevocation to return crate::Result; removed use pkix_path::Result
description: pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:41 -- RevocationChecker::check_revocation returns pkix_path::Result<()>, but pkix_path::Error has no Revoked variant. When CrlChecker or OcspChecker is implemented there will be no type-safe way to express certificate revocation. Fix requires: (1) define pkix_revocation::Error with at minimum a Revoked { index: usize } variant, (2) change RevocationChecker::check_revocation to return core::result::Result<(), pkix_revocation::Error>, (3) add pkix_chain::Error as a combined enum with Path(pkix_path::Error) and Revocation(pkix_revocation::Error) variants, (4) change pkix_chain::verify_chain return type to Result<ValidatedPath, pkix_chain::Error>. Currently pkix-chain re-exports pkix_path::Error as its own error which will break as soon as revocation errors exist.
title: RevocationChecker returns pkix_path::Result but pkix_path::Error has no Revoked variant
